What’s so grand about !grandsauna? The details, the care and attention we bring to each of our customers! We take infrared sauna repair to a new level – guaranteed top quality help, qualified experts and authentic spare parts especially for you and your comfort.



Grandsauna is great in many ways and offers wide possibilities to get healthier, slimmer and happier – all this and so much more at the comfort of your home or backyard. Skin purification, detoxification, better sleep and pain relief – this is what our saunas give our customers and a pleasurable price.
